chapter: Early music and the Jack Carey band
title: Jack Carey's band: personnel and towns played
summary: Names the six-piece band: Carey and Punch on trumpet, Babe Joseph Phillip on bass, drummer Voynell Joseph at times, and clarinetists Burbank and Georgia Boy.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Can you tell us who else was in the band when you played with Jack Carrey?
But, Jack, as far as I can remember, I can call some of the names.
Yes.
You mean you want the name?
Yes. Any of the other people, the other instruments. How big a band was it? Do you remember about how many?
How big the band was? No more than six pieces. Six. Six pieces. Well, Jack Carrey and the same fellow that going trumpet now, Punch. Oh, Punch, yeah. He was going trumpet.
He told me he played his own.
And Joseph Phillip was a bass violin player.
Oh.
Joseph Phillip.
Was that the same, wait a minute? Babe, they called him Babe. Called him Babe.
Babe, yeah, that's it. He died.
I knew him.
He was our bass player.
I'm making some records with him one time.
He was our bass player. Babe. And Jack Carrey. And myself. And Punch. Let's see who they had on drums. Well, he did have a regular drum player. Sometimes he'd grab, uh... Goodness.
Let me call this drum player.
Yeah. Sometimes he'd grab a little fella named Voynell Joseph.
Oh, I've heard of him.
I don't know. I never did know. Well, sometimes he'd grab him on his drums.
Remember who the clarinet player was?
Yeah, no. The clarinet player, and I... Let's see. Sometime he'd have... This fella, Burybank. Sometime he'd have Burybank with him. Play clarinet.
Punch said he used to play some of the Georgia Boy. Georgia Boy. Did you see in the band?
Georgia Boy? Yeah. Sometime he'd have Georgia Boy. Sometime he'd have Georgia Boy with him.
Where did you all play in those days?
In those days?
What kind of jobs did they have?
Where did we play in those days? Different parts. Morgan City. Uh... Lake Charles. Morganser. St. Jones Parish. Several around. In my parish in Kelowna. And, uh... Mandeville, Covington. Oh, yeah.
All around.
Oh, yeah. Mandeville, Covington. And, uh... Slidell. Yeah. Bugaloosa.
Mm-hmm.
Biloxi. Paschristine.
Yeah. Oh, yeah. I didn't know they traveled so much.
Oh, yeah.
